StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Sniper_Elite_4
Fandom (sniperelite.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://sniperelite.fandom.com/wiki/Sniper_Elite_4
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 312660; its Steam schema names the app "New_Project_01" (a placeholder name). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); of its subpages only "Table of Contents" and one mission page, "Allagra Fortress", are written, and the Walkthrough and other mission pages it links are not, so it was not used for structure. sniperelite.fandom.com has the page, with about 159 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Only 1 of 85 Steam achievements is hidden ("The Path of Most Resistance", 20.5%); it sits in the campaign chapter as a placeholder. Target Führer, Inception, Infiltration and Obliteration each have a block of achievements named for them, so each gets a chapter; the data does not say whether they are add-ons. The eight campaign missions are numbered only ("Complete Mission 1" to 8), so their names are not given. "Overwatch 1" and "Overwatch 2" are not explained in the data; they sit with the multiplayer and co-op chapter.
